# 8553 - TRI-STATE 8-bit latch with common input/output pins

Package DIP-16 · family 8000 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/8553.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/8553.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 50 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![8553 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/8553.png) | ![8553 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-8553.png) | ![8553 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-8553.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | READ1 | enable | low |  | controls pins 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12; when not enabled: float |
| 2 | ENABLE | enable | low |  | controls pins 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12; when not enabled: float |
| 3 | CLEAR | input | high |  | acts at once (not clocked) |
| 4 | IO1 | output |  | three-state | enabled by ENABLE,READ1,READ2; bidirectional: data input when floating, latch output when read |
| 5 | IO2 | output |  | three-state | enabled by ENABLE,READ1,READ2; bidirectional: data input when floating, latch output when read |
| 6 | IO3 | output |  | three-state | enabled by ENABLE,READ1,READ2; bidirectional: data input when floating, latch output when read |
| 7 | IO4 | output |  | three-state | enabled by ENABLE,READ1,READ2; bidirectional: data input when floating, latch output when read |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 9 | IO5 | output |  | three-state | enabled by ENABLE,READ1,READ2; bidirectional: data input when floating, latch output when read |
| 10 | IO6 | output |  | three-state | enabled by ENABLE,READ1,READ2; bidirectional: data input when floating, latch output when read |
| 11 | IO7 | output |  | three-state | enabled by ENABLE,READ1,READ2; bidirectional: data input when floating, latch output when read |
| 12 | IO8 | output |  | three-state | enabled by ENABLE,READ1,READ2; bidirectional: data input when floating, latch output when read |
| 13 | WRITE2 | input | low |  |  |
| 14 | WRITE1 | input | low |  |  |
| 15 | READ2 | enable | low |  | controls pins 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12; when not enabled: float |
| 16 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 4,5,6,7,9,10,11,12 | IOn = latch n when ENABLE' AND READ1' AND READ2' AND WRITE1 AND WRITE2; otherwise Z | The I/O pins drive the stored byte only when ENABLE and both READ inputs are low and both WRITE inputs are high (read). Otherwise they float and act as inputs. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 8

Changes on: level (transparent latch while writing)

- CLEAR H, ENABLE L, READ L, WRITE H: enter L into all latches, bus shows L
- CLEAR H, ENABLE L, READ L, WRITE L: enter L, bus Hi-Z
- CLEAR L, ENABLE L, READ H, WRITE H: do nothing, bus Hi-Z
- CLEAR L, ENABLE H: do nothing, bus Hi-Z
- CLEAR L, ENABLE L, WRITE L: write, latches take the bus levels
- CLEAR L, ENABLE L, READ L, WRITE H: read, bus shows the latches

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CLEAR | IO | PHL | 21 | 32 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 50 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| ENABLE/READ | IO | PZH | 22 | 33 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 50 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| ENABLE/READ | IO | PZL | 25 | 38 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 50 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| ENABLE/READ | IO | PHZ | 7 | 12 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 5 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| ENABLE/READ | IO | PLZ | 20 | 30 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 5 pF, RL 400 ohm |

## Timing limits

| What | Pin | Against | Min ns |
|---|---|---|---|
| pulseWidth | CLEAR |  | 15 |
| pulseWidth | WRITE |  | 40 |
| setup | IO (high level) | WRITE | 20 |
| setup | IO (low level) | WRITE | 36 |
| hold | IO (high level) | WRITE | -15 |
| hold | IO (low level) | WRITE | -8 |

## Not known

- The reference signal for data setup/hold (taken as WRITE) is not named in the text read; the timing waveform was not read.
- In the truth table READ and WRITE mean "both READ inputs" / "both WRITE inputs"; behaviour with the two READ (or two WRITE) pins at different levels is not stated.
- No minimum delays printed.

## Notes

The IO pins are both inputs and three-state outputs; given role output with a text note.

- [National Semiconductor 1976 TTL Databook, DM75/DM8553 TRI-STATE 8-Bit Latches](https://www.bitsavers.org/components/national/_dataBooks/1976_National_TTL_Databook.pdf) - pdf 415-416 (printed 3-70, 3-71); DM8553
